subject: Post-call recap: AcmeHealth private VPC / on-prem requirements
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@acmehealth.com>, Tom Reed <tom.reed@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 17:45:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap: AcmeHealth private VPC / on-prem requirements

Hi Alice & Tom

Thanks for taking the time today to walk through AcmeHealth's requirements. Quick recap from our side while it's fresh:

Attendees:
- Alice Johnson (AcmeHealth - Product)
- Tom Reed (AcmeHealth - IT Ops)
- Marissa Cole (Redwood Inference)
- Rafael Mendes (Redwood Solutions Engineering)

Key pain points you called out:
- Strict data residency: PHI must remain in-region and stored on customer-managed infrastructure.
- Network isolation/air-gap requirement for certain workloads (e.g., staging + analytic pipelines).
- Need for KMS integration and HSM options for encryption-at-rest keys.
- Audit/logging retention for 7+ years and exportable audit trails for compliance.

Goals we aligned on:
1) Proof-of-concept (private VPC deployment) that demonstrates inference latency and throughput within your dev network.
2) Clear networking checklist so your infra team can open the minimum firewall rules for the installer and runtime.
3) Security artifacts (SOC 2 summary, data flow diagrams, encryption options) for legal and InfoSec review.

Constraints we noted:
- Air-gapped environments may require an on-prem installer and staging artifact transfer process.
- Timeline: AcmeHealth wants a POC no later than end of Q1 2027.

Immediate next steps (agreed):
- Redwood: Share a concise networking checklist and a one-page deployment options matrix (on-prem vs. VPC) attached. (Marissa, Rafael) by EOD Wednesday.
- AcmeHealth: Confirm primary contact for infra (Tom) and legal/security reviewers (Alice) and share any existing internal network appliance/vendor that could block outbound connections.
- Schedule a 90-minute technical workshop with your infra and security teams (suggested windows below). Rafael will lead the workshop.

Suggested workshop slots (PST):
- Wed, Dec 8, 10:00 - 11:30
- Thu, Dec 9, 13:00 - 14:30

Attachments: redwood-private-vpc-quickstart.pdf (1-pager), acme-networking-checklist.xlsx

If I missed anything important, please flag otherwise I'll follow up with the checklist and a calendar invite for the workshop once you confirm a slot.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Tom Reed <tom.reed@acmehealth.com>

Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: AcmeHealth private VPC / on-prem requirements

Marissa

Thanks for the clear recap. A couple quick clarifications from our infra/security side:

1) For air-gapped sites we need to understand the installer footprint and whether the runtime requires any outbound connections during normal operation (not just for updates).
2) Firewall: our security team allows a short list of outbound IPs/domains for telemetry and licensing. Can you provide the minimum set (IPs/domains) or an offline licensing option?
3) KMS/HSM: we use an on-prem HSM (Luna). Will Redwood be able to integrate with customer-managed HSM via standard PKCS#11?

We can do Thu, Dec 9 at 13:00 PST for the workshop please send the invite and any pre-reads.

Tom

Subject: Re: Post-call recap: AcmeHealth private VPC / on-prem requirements

Tom

Great thanks for the fast reply and the confirmation on the workshop slot. Quick answers and what we'll bring to the workshop:

- Installer footprint & offline mode: Rafael will walk through the on-prem installer options. We have an offline bundle that includes the runtime + model artifacts; it does not require outbound connections for inference but periodic connectivity is used for metrics and optional model updates. We'll document the exact behaviors and the frequency of any outbound telemetry (can be disabled).

- Minimum outbound endpoints / offline licensing: We'll provide a precise list of IP ranges and hostnames for the minimal outbound set. We also support an offline licensing key flow for fully air-gapped installs. Rafael will cover the CLI activation flow.

- HSM / KMS: We support PKCS#11 integrations and have successfully integrated with Luna and other HSMs. We'll include a short sample for key rollover and encryption-at-rest configuration.

Action items (Redwood):
- Share IPs/domains + offline licensing instructions (Rafael) by Tue, Dec 7.
- Send calendar invite for workshop Thu, Dec 9 13:00 - 14:30 PST with a short agenda and pre-reads (Marissa) today.
- Provide SOC 2 summary + data flow diagrams for legal review (Vivek) by Dec 8.

Tom/Alice: If you can share any internal network appliance vendor names (e.g., Palo Alto, Zscaler), Rafael can tailor the checklist.

Link to POC workspace & docs: https://redwood.app/s/ACME-PRIV-2026
DocuSign link for the NDA (optional pre-POC): https://www.docusign.net/envelope/EXAMPLE-ACME-2026

I'll follow up with the attachments and the invite shortly.

Thanks!
